_meta.purpose: Per-arch microbench baseline. Codec PRs gate against these numbers (>5% throughput regression blocks merge). Update by re-running the bench.

constant_32MiB._note: Write-bandwidth bound near the GDDR6 fill ceiling.

uncompressed_multi_1024x32KiB_raw_memcpy._note: Reference only — dispatcher bypassed, per-segment cudaMemcpyAsync. Demonstrates why the batched kernel exists.

rle_long_runs_int64._note: Pending measurement on sm_75. PR 3 will populate.

rle_medium_runs_int64._note: Pending measurement on sm_75. PR 3 will populate. cumsum fits in shmem (4 KiB).

rle_short_runs_int32_gmem._note: Pending measurement on sm_75. PR 3 will populate. cumsum > RLE_SMEM_MAX_ENTRIES → gmem-binary-search path.

tunables._note: Per-CTA work bound for the chunked memcpy kernel. Tuned on Turing; re-measure on Ampere/Hopper if those become primary. RLE_SMEM_MAX_ENTRIES caps per-CTA shmem cumsum cache at 16 KiB; chunks above this fall back to gmem-binary-search.
